verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly documents card-level spend limits, granular user permissions, and card lifecycle controls ('Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions'; virtual card issuance with per-card limits via API), and this is corroborated by a 5-year customer describing 'hundreds of virtual debit cards with individual limits.' Missing for 10: more detail on per-employee role-based control granularity and independent finance-lead-specific usage reports beyond one customer anecdote.
